title: Reviewer Bulletin: Allowed Amount at Issue on the Line Opening a Late-Filing Reconsideration
content:
**Reviewer bulletin — Appeals and Grievances: allowed amount at issue on the line opening a case**

Applies to a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on a TRICARE Select claim line that was denied because the claim reached the region after the claim filing deadline.

> The allowed amount at issue on the line opening a case is set from the provider's own paid lines for the patient: where the provider has three or more paid TRICARE Select lines for the patient in the line opening a case's service class posted in the twelve months before the day the amount is figured, it is the average of their allowed amounts, rounded to the cent; where it has one or two such lines, it is the allowed amount of the provider's most recently posted paid line in that class for the patient; where it has none, it is the amount the provider billed on the line opening a case, which for a nonparticipating provider is first divided by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit so that nothing such a provider may bill above the allowed amount comes into dispute, rounded to the cent.

In figures: the look-back runs 12 months, and the average is used from 3 paid lines upward. The paid lines read are the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines with the line outcome paid, from the same provider and in the same service class as the line opening a case. The balance-billing limit is the nonparticipating balance-billing limit percentage of the TRICARE Select tier the line was billed under, taken as hundredths of one (a limit of p percent divides by one plus p hundredths); the division applies only where the provider is recorded on the line opening a case as non-network nonparticipating.

A paid line counts as posted in the twelve months before the day the amount is figured when fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its posted date to that day: figured on 2026-10-11 (a hypothetical date), a line posted on 2025-10-12 counts, while a line posted on 2025-10-11 — 12 whole months earlier — does not.

**Decision table**

| Paid lines of the provider for the patient in that service class, posted in the last 12 months | Allowed amount at issue |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the average of their allowed amounts, rounded to the cent |
| 1 or 2 | the allowed amount of the provider's most recently posted paid line in that class for the patient |
| none | the billed amount on the line; for a nonparticipating provider, divided by one plus the balance-billing limit, rounded to the cent |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)**

- *3 lines* (hypothetical allowed amounts 120.00, 135.50 and 141.25): total 396.75, divided by 3, gives 132.25.
- *2 lines* (hypothetical 118.00 posted first, 126.40 posted most recently): 126.40. Two lines is one short of the 3 needed for an average.
- *no line*, participating provider, billed 460.00 (hypothetical): 460.00.
- *no line*, nonparticipating provider, billed 460.00 with a hypothetical 15 percent limit: 460.00 divided by 1.15 gives 400.00.
